REFERENCE-SCOPE TRANSPARENT SUCCESSOR READY FOR REREVIEW.

Candidate cand-7EHQ3HND7ZVZ99K66J983K7Q5M is exact commit 26df8dc2965e28f1da45d8a8b10cec9f1041b9b0, sole parent/base e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a, with exactly tools/reference-scope.sh and tools/reference-scope-test.sh. The blocked cand-4VPHY752ZPYM29MC5GKBW7A4AD is proposer-superseded.

The shared BASE/HEAD recognizer now keeps the ordinary Scala 3 declaration-modifier family together: qualified private/protected, abstract, final, sealed, case, implicit, lazy, override, inline, infix, transparent, open, and erased. The deliberate opaque-type exclusion remains unchanged. A new lawful surviving-consumer court modifies both transparent trait TransparentApi and transparent class TransparentClassApi in core while features consumes both; it requires both names, both modules, and coreJVM/test plus featuresJVM/test.

Exact-commit evidence: regression court PASS 75/75; bash -n pass; ShellCheck pass; git diff --check pass; worktree clean. Docs replay e584ad6..8a227832 exits 0 with no types. ONNX replay f888f9a..fed6c178 emits codecJVM/test, embedBench/test, embedCoreJVM/test, and embedOnnx/test. Mutation removing only transparent from the modifier family fails exactly the new court: TransparentApi is missing and the tool prints no types defined in changed files. Restored bytes pass 75/75.

SHA-256: tools/reference-scope.sh 68cd4267acdf03fde2190945d9050e10f07e6a455a53803636a7b5aa62d537e6; tools/reference-scope-test.sh 3b39ddc79f2f871d31a9d3c23210bcd0e2e63b4f5fa8ec355898db2091440eb5. No authorization or landing is claimed; the ancestor candidate remains separately unresolved.
